items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: "Ruby" is one I wouldn’t know it if I heard it.

ctx.x: I think it’s very pretty. I’ve learned to play that by hearing him and another piano player wrote down lead line for it and it’s a gorgeous thing. And yet some other people have told me are the ones, “Ruby” is one I wouldn’t know it if I heard it. But this “‘Round Midnight” is a hit with me.
Beautiful. And tough, a tough tune too.
